githubAppAccess: GitHub sign-in shows repositories where the Shelf GitHub App is installed and you have access. A personal access token uses the repositories and permissions you selected when creating it.
githubWrongPassphrase: That passphrase did not unlock the saved sign-in.
githubTryLater: Wait a moment before trying another passphrase.
githubSessionEnded: GitHub sign-in is locked or expired. Reconnect to continue. Your pending changes are saved.
githubSignInError: GitHub sign-in did not finish. Try again.
githubRevokeError: Signed out locally. Review Shelf access in your GitHub settings to revoke the grant.
githubCreateOnGitHub: Create your repository on GitHub, add it to the Shelf installation, then refresh.
